question: How does the age distribution differ between the Autumn 2025 In-Person and Online cohorts?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the retrieved context, the age distributions for the In-Person and Online programs are as follows:

- **In-Person Program:** 21-24: 72%, 25-29: 20%, 30-34: 5%, 35+: 3% [1]
- **Online Program:** 21-24: 44.4%, 25-29: 14.8%, 30-34: 25.9%, 35+: 14.8% [2]

The In-Person cohort is significantly younger, with 72% of students aged 21-24, while the Online cohort has a more balanced distribution, with a larger share of older students (40.7% are 30 or older, compared to 8% for the In-Person program) [1][2].

Sources:
1. [Our Students | Age Breakdown (In-Person & Online) > In-Person Program Age Breakdown](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/our-students/)
2. [Our Students | Age Breakdown (In-Person & Online) > Online Program Age Breakdown](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/our-students/)
